decisions: Use unit, integration, and e2e as the exclusive primary Go/Ginkgo taxonomy labels.
Define Go/Ginkgo e2e as acting on the LeafWiki product binary or command build artifact.
Exclude Playwright and Docker proxy tests from this Go/Ginkgo label taxonomy.
Use semantichygiene for invalid-label hard failures.
Keep missing labels report-only during the parallel cleanup phase.
Use a separate taxonomy worktree or branch and integrate small commits.
